title: Freemasonry — Craft, Rites, Temple Symbols and Geometry
purpose: Give the repository a precise Freemasonry model so Craft degrees, Royal Arch, Scottish Rite, York Rite, Temple/pillar symbolism, square-and-compasses, working tools and sacred-geometry claims are not collapsed into one generic 33-step occult pyramid.
master_rule: Freemasonry is federated and jurisdiction-dependent. Always state jurisdiction/body. The three Craft degrees are not the same thing as the Scottish Rite's numbered degrees, and York Rite bodies are not a continuation of Scottish Rite numbering.

canonical_three_degrees.name: Entered Apprentice
canonical_three_degrees.structural_theme: initiation/equality/first entry into the lodge tradition

canonical_three_degrees.name: Fellow Craft
canonical_three_degrees.structural_theme: education, development, skilled work and further formation

canonical_three_degrees.name: Master Mason
canonical_three_degrees.structural_theme: maturity, mortality, memory and responsible use of life

craft_masonry.england_royal_arch_relation: Under UGLE's 1813 formulation, pure Antient Masonry consists of the three degrees and includes the Supreme Order of the Holy Royal Arch as an indissolubly linked completion/extension rather than a fourth Craft degree in the ordinary count.

scottish_rite_southern_jurisdiction_refe.precondition: Master Mason in regular Craft Masonry

full_degree_names.name: Knight of the East and West
Knight of the Royal Axe / Prince of Libanus
Knight of the Sun / Prince Adept

scottish_rite_southern_jurisdiction_refe.degree_33: The 33° is associated with the Supreme Council / Inspector General distinction rather than a normal sequential working degree that every Scottish Rite Mason automatically receives.
scottish_rite_southern_jurisdiction_refe.boundary: Exact titles, requirements and conferral practice vary by Supreme Council/jurisdiction.

commandery_orders: Illustrious Order of the Red Cross
york_rite_us_reference.structural_note: The Commandery confers Orders rather than merely extending a single numbered degree ladder.

temple_threshold_architecture.solomons_temple: A major symbolic architecture in Masonic ritual and later bodies; building, loss, recovery, completion and dedication recur as narrative operators.
temple_threshold_architecture.jachin_boaz: Biblical named pillars flanking the Temple entrance become important later Masonic threshold symbols. Preserve biblical provenance and later Masonic reception as different strata.
temple_threshold_architecture.unfinished_completed_temple_distinction: Different degree systems use Temple building/completion/recovery in different ways; do not flatten all rites into one Temple story.
temple_threshold_architecture.potato_use: Temple can be compared with House; pillars with threshold supports; building with disciplined formation; lost/recovered word with provenance/knowledge recovery. These are comparative functions, not evidence of historical Potato doctrine.

square.masonic_symbolic_use: moral rectitude / right conduct in common Masonic explanation
square.geometry: two perpendicular directions; 90° relation; local orthogonality

compasses.masonic_symbolic_use: self-limitation, relation and bounded conduct in common explanations
compasses.geometry: fixed center + radius -> locus/circle; can construct intersections and proportional figures

common_us_associations: God / Great Architect language in many jurisdictions
letter_g.caution: Not universal in every jurisdiction or period.

rough_and_perfect_ashlar.boundary: Masonic ethical-symbolic use is not a literal psychological measurement.

point_circle_center.project_use: center/radius/boundary is mathematically precise and useful for House/Door construction, but Masonic center symbolism must be sourced to its own ritual/writing rather than inferred from generic Euclid.

sacred_geometry_boundary.rule: A geometric construction can be exact while its symbolic interpretation remains tradition-specific. Mathematical coincidence does not prove secret lineage.
sacred_geometry_boundary.potato_relation: The Potato of Life may use exact Vesica geometry as its native mathematical skeleton, then layer Masonic, Christian, Kabbalistic or other comparators only with typed provenance.

topology_relations.lodge: bounded social/ritual room; not identical with House as global project organism
topology_relations.east: orientation/seat of lodge leadership in many Craft settings; useful directional comparator, not Potato North
topology_relations.degree: institutionally authorized transition/status in a rite
topology_relations.working_tool: physical instrument transformed into ethical/symbolic teaching device
topology_relations.geometry: formal relation independent of the moral allegory later attached to it

anti_collapse_rules: Do not call all Freemasonry 'Scottish Rite'.
Do not call the 33° the 33rd universal Masonic step.
Do not merge York Rite and Scottish Rite sequences.
Do not treat Great Seal pyramid courses as Masonic degrees.
Do not backdate later Masonic pillar meanings into 1 Kings.
Do not infer organizational connection from shared Eye, compass, pillar, triangle, Temple, 33 or Vesica motifs alone.
